name: DPM++ 2M, 2M SDE, 3M SDE with Dy churn
plain: Core DPM++ multistep updates preceded by a fixed sigma inflation at each step, with no half-resolution call. The Dy name here means a churn schedule by s_dy_pow.
math: γ=√2−1, or γ(1−(i/(N−1))^s_dy_pow) if s_dy_pow≥0. σ̂=σᵢ(1+γ). x ← x − ε√(σ̂²−σᵢ²), then standard 2M, 2M SDE or 3M SDE from σ̂.

providers.author: pamparamm
providers.note: sample_dpmpp_3m_dy dispatcher; sample_dpmpp_2m_dy_cfg_pp is the CFG++ twin

label: from code
surprise: Noise is subtracted before the model call, opposite sign to core churn.
